title: Query Entity-Oriented Graph Neural Networks for Knowledge Graph Completion
abstract: arXiv:2606.05639v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Knowledge Graph Completion (KGC) aims at predicting missing triplets from incomplete knowledge graphs, which is crucial for downstream applications. Recently, Graph Neural Network (GNN)-based methods have achieved remarkable success by performing message passing over a local subgraph centered on the query entity. In these methods, the query relation conditions message computation and aggregation, whereas the query entity serves only as a structural anchor for subgraph extraction. The query relation thus constitutes the sole explicit signal for evidence selection, even though the relevant evidence for the same relation can differ substantially across query entities. We propose Q-GNN, which incorporates the query entity as an explicit conditioning signal. translated_title: 面向查询实体的图神经网络用于知识图谱补全
translated_abstract: 知识图谱补全（KGC）旨在从不完整的知识图谱中预测缺失的三元组，这对下游应用至关重要。近年来，基于图神经网络（GNN）的方法通过在以查询实体为中心的局部子图上进行消息传递，取得了显著的成功。在这类方法中，查询关系用于调控消息的计算与聚合，而查询实体仅作为子图提取的结构锚点。因此，查询关系成为证据选择的唯一显式信号，尽管针对同一关系的相关证据在不同查询实体之间可能存在显著差异。我们提出了Q-GNN，它将查询实体作为显式的条件信号加以利用。Q-GNN通过查询实体的局部结构上下文和语义类型来刻画查询实体，因此在不完备的归纳式（inductive）设置下仍然适用。结构上下文由专门的编码器进行编码。
tldr: 提出Q-GNN模型，将查询实体的局部结构上下文和语义类型作为显式条件信号融入图神经网络的消息传递过程，从而提升知识图谱补全在转导与归纳设置下的性能。
en_tdlr: Q-GNN introduces the query entity as an explicit conditioning signal—characterized by its local structural context and semantic type—into GNN-based knowledge graph completion, remaining applicable in the inductive setting.
